extractor.note: Whole file grep-scanned for the theme's search terms plus 'Wesensschau', 'immutable', 'innate', 'Descartes', 'residuum', 'free variation' and 'simple nature'. Closely read the three sections where the theme is a term of art: the eidetic shape of psychic interiority (lines 739-744), individuality and identity of time-objects (773-776) and the tode ti (797-802). No stratum is assigned: chronology.json distinguishes a 1917 and a 1918 layer for this volume, and the appended texts read here do not state which they belong to.

coverage_note: Covers three short sections of the appended texts - 'The Time-Relation of the Pure Ego' § 1, 'Temporal Streaming and the Constitution of Individual Objectual Being' § 1, and 'On the Phenomenology of Individuation' § 2. The main body of the Bernau manuscripts on protention and retention, which carries most of the file's 'essential' hits adverbially, was keyword-scanned only.

units.claim: The section is said to characterize the general essence without which a unified interiority is unthinkable.
units.quote: Husserl characterizes the general essence without which a unified interiority is unthinkable.

units.claim: The essential lawfulness of time-constituting consciousness is called the primordially first and deepest lawfulness of a consciousness-genesis and of the primal constitution of objectivities.
units.quote: The essential lawfulness of this time-constituting consciousness is the primordially first and deepest lawfulness of a consciousness-genesis

units.claim: Ur-genesis as eidetic form, the form of the constitution of immanent hyletic objects, is said to underlie every further genesis.
units.quote: Ur-genesis (as eidetic form) — the form of the constitution of immanent hyletic objects — underlies every further genesis.

units.claim: The full sense identical across experience and phantasy is called the individual essence of the object, encompassing its time-duration and the distribution of its temporal filling.
units.quote: This full sense is the individual essence (*individuelles Wesen*) of the object, encompassing its identical time-duration and the distribution of its temporal filling over this duration.

units.claim: The individual essence is said to be a universal in that it is an identical general particularizing itself here and there, as individual actuality or individual possibility.
units.quote: It is one in that it is an identical general that particularizes itself here and there, as individual actuality or individual possibility.

units.claim: Returning to the Ideas I distinction of sachhaltig essence and tode ti, concrete essence is said to contain abstract essences, every essence being individualized through the tode ti.
units.quote: Concrete essence contains abstract (non-independent) essences; every essence is individualized through the τόδε τι.

units.claim: To the logical essence of essence is said to belong being an identical universal in relation to an open pure possibility of an infinite range of particulars, each an absolute once-only this-here.
units.quote: to the logical essence of essence belongs being an identical universal in relation to an open pure possibility of an infinite range of particulars — each an absolute once-only this-here

units.claim: Temporal extension is said to belong to the formal essence of the concretum and, as a moment of an essence, to be itself an abstract essence in a distinguished position.
units.quote: temporal extension, as moment of an essence, is itself an abstract essence occupying a distinguished position

absences.expected_because: This section states what the logical essence of essence is - an identical universal over an infinite range of once-only particulars - which is the anti-nominalist thesis the theme was opened to trace, and states it without the method by which such an essence is seen or any rival account of its standing.
absences.note: Bears on gap-007. The universality of essence is grounded here in the tode ti and in temporal individuation, not in variation, innateness or immutability.
